newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-MOTIVATED PEREC TO RUN IN WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MOTIVATED PEREC TO RUN IN WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: French double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec has found the motivation she needs to compete in next month's world championships and will run the women's 200 meters in Athens, her coach said Wednesday.
Perec, who earlier said she would skip the championships, changed her mind because "she realises she can do very well in the games," John Smith said.

The women's 200 and 400 meters champion has had difficulty motivating herself this year after her tremendous success at the Atlanta Games. "But Tuesday at practice she said, 'I have found something,'" Smith said.
Although she has lost all three 200 meters races this year, "she will be in shape by the championships," Smith said.
"It's been a motivational thing," the Los Angeles-based coach said. "Physically it's not a problem. She's had some problems with her legs, but she's fine now as far as I know.
"We're going to go for it, and see what she has. I commend her on that. Most people would have thrown in the towel. At least she is going to give it a valid effort.
"You'll see her at her best or you'll see her at her worst."
